description: This Java interface defines the EntityFields interface with various default getter methods for entity attributes, including ID, name, type, location details, and related identifiers, along with a method to retrieve attribute values as strings.

classes.name: EntityFields
classes.description: A Java interface providing default methods to access various entity attributes, with a method to get attribute values as strings based on keys.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the UUID of the entity.

methods.name: getTenantId
methods.description: Default method returning null, to get the tenant UUID.

methods.name: getCustomerId
methods.description: Default method returning null, to get the customer UUID.

methods.name: getAssignedCustomerIds
methods.description: Default method returning an empty list of UUIDs for assigned customers.

methods.name: getCreatedTime
methods.description: Default method returning 0, to get the creation timestamp.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Default method returning an empty string, to get the entity's name.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Default method returning an empty string, to get the entity's type.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Default method returning an empty string, to get the label.

methods.name: getAdditionalInfo
methods.description: Default method returning an empty string, to get additional info.

methods.name: getEmail
methods.description: Default method returning an empty string, to get email.

methods.name: getCountry
methods.description: Default method returning an empty string, to get country.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Default method returning an empty string, to get state.

methods.name: getCity
methods.description: Default method returning an empty string, to get city.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Default method returning an empty string, to get address.

methods.name: getAddress2
methods.description: Default method returning an empty string, to get secondary address.

methods.name: getZip
methods.description: Default method returning an empty string, to get ZIP code.

methods.name: getPhone
methods.description: Default method returning an empty string, to get phone number.

methods.name: getRegion
methods.description: Default method returning an empty string, to get region.

methods.name: getFirstName
methods.description: Default method returning an empty string, to get first name.

methods.name: getLastName
methods.description: Default method returning an empty string, to get last name.

methods.name: isEdgeTemplate
methods.description: Default method returning false, to indicate if entity is an edge template.

methods.name: getConfiguration
methods.description: Default method returning an empty string, to get configuration details.

methods.name: getSchedule
methods.description: Default method returning an empty string, to get schedule info.

methods.name: getOriginatorId
methods.description: Default method returning null, to get the originator's EntityId.

methods.name: getQueueName
methods.description: Default method returning an empty string, to get queue name.

methods.name: getServiceId
methods.description: Default method returning an empty string, to get service ID.

methods.name: isDefault
methods.description: Default method returning false, indicating if entity is default.

methods.name: getOwnerId
methods.description: Default method returning null, to get owner UUID.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Default method returning null, to get version number.

methods.name: getAsString
methods.description: Method returning string representation of attribute based on key, with special handling for known keys and warning for unknown keys.
